quota_basis: Actual module-count distribution of the frozen v3 train16000 members
selection: Import all qualifying existing records, then lowest accepted/quota stratum first; deterministic candidate order; stop each stratum at quota
expansion: Only split_v1 train shards; SHA256('E14.q104.v1:'+shard) ranked within each worker; round-robin workers; rows ranked with same hash prefix and shard:row; apply unchanged MIB compatibility transformation
registration: bank.sqlite3 candidates includes original and expanded members, N, origin and every outcome; accepted.json is the exported training membership
validation: Original v3 dev2000 and fixed dev_monitor500 remain unfiltered and disjoint from all teacher train candidates
Q_scope: Neutral-time diagnostic Q with original reference denominators after input-area transformation; not an official contest score or student-model result
failure_policy: Quality rejection continues including Q>2; hard/solver/data errors stop and leave candidate pending for investigated retry
